name: Model N Channel
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: knobs report only their 0-1 position, so values go through tables measured with tools/build-table.mjs. Replaces the Rea-Sixty draft (which had the filters swapped).

Neve-style: high and low are fixed shelves, the mid is a bell; frequencies and filters are stepped (nearest step). Routing 'Pre EQ' = compressor before the EQ, 'Post EQ' after (labels confirmed by the table of 2026-11-23). Ratio and recovery are stepped; recovery AUTO carries to other strips' auto release.
Preamp, Nuance/Slam, makeup and the analog options are not mapped.
